title: nbn 25/10 $18.99/M for 3-Months, 500/50 $37.99/M for 3-Months (Selected Locations That Are Not Currently Using nbn) @ Arctel
body:
Deal: nbn 25/10 $18.99/M for 3-Months, 500/50 $37.99/M for 3-Months (Selected Locations That Are Not Currently Using nbn) @ Arctel

[Mechz] If only the NBN didn't want to cut up my driveway to bring a cable to my wall. I might get connected.
[GeoK] I use 5g. Not applying the discount!
Super Fast $67.99/mo
[Team Triforce] Unfortunately the 180,000 sites are specified by the NBN :(
[GeoK] So it's slected Unconnected NBN, not all of them!
[GeoK] @Team Triforce: Doesn't really, this is targeted deal.
[freefall101] @Team Triforce: Maybe try toning down the marketing on the title and aim for clarity instead.
[Team Triforce] @freefall101: Open to ideas… but there is a 180,000 LOC ID’s that it’s applicable too, so we want to give them a chance!
The only way you’ll know is if you search!
[samehada] so how do I get this discount? The signup form just show the full price…
[Team Triforce] Unfortunately we don’t know your LOC ID, but the 180,000 sites that it is applicable too get the discount.
[Team Triforce] If your site is applicable, the site will show you a notification & add a special code to your order.
[samehada] @Team Triforce: the only coupon I can see is Coupon: 24-mnth-cruisy-lite-$0.00
I don't have NBN connected at my house, the deal detail is so unclear
[Team Triforce] @samehada: Unfortunately we have no way of knowing you are one of the 180,000 sites until you search…
[thespensa] Hey OP, you may want to adjust the pop up after inputting your address.
It said I was eligible for this promotion, but the full price showed up at the bottom.
[Team Triforce] Hello,
We can see the pricing at the bottom of the page is not updating with the promotion, this is because it’s applied at the checkout.
If you select your location, modem option & press checkout, you will see the revised price.
Your place is definitely eligible, so would be great to see you setup!
Thanks,
Hus
[Be careful] Fix the title say ‘no nbn cabling not ‘not connected’ as they infers cabled but not currently paid for. Misleading.
[Team Triforce] Hi, that’s not the definition. Will update the tittle, we are trying to communicate an oppurtunity for people to take advantage off, nothing misleading.
[brianmau] Not using NBN since June 2022 but ineligible.
[Team Triforce] We also have to run a buisness… nobody is passing any of these rebates back, we have some of the best monthly & on-going prices.
Rather than always wanting more, how about supporting us for giving as much as we can back?
Hus
[HerryL] Hi, we have some tenants who need to set up internet service. Would you be interested in partnering with us?
